messages.subject: debugging with browser()
parts: When I put a browser() function in a renderPrint, any on-the-fly printing while in debug mode is stored and then output to the shiny app rather than Rstudio console.  But this only occurs when the renderPrint exits.  Is there any way to have the printing sent directly to the live console?  Essentially what I am trying to do is "watch" variable values while the code is in debug mode.
